title: skeleton template variables
description: Values for templates/skeleton.md.j2 and templates/skeleton.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from skeleton.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

alert_id.title: Alert id
alert_id.description: The alerting tool's issue id. From section 'Alert'.

assertion_1.title: Assertion 1
assertion_1.description: The assertion 1 used under 'Red Test (committed FIRST)'.

assertion_2.title: Assertion 2
assertion_2.description: The assertion 2 used under 'Red Test (committed FIRST)'.

ci_run_url.title: Ci run url
ci_run_url.description: The ci run url used under 'Verification'.

diff_lines.title: Diff lines
diff_lines.description: Lines changed by the fix. From section 'Fix'.

fix_commit.title: Fix commit
fix_commit.description: First commit touching production code, on top of the red test. From section 'Fix'.

json_snippet.title: Json snippet
json_snippet.description: Reproducing inputs lifted from the alert payload, PII replaced field-by-field. From section 'Alert'.

merged_at.title: Merged at
merged_at.description: Merge date of the fix PR, YYYY-MM-DD. From section 'Review'.

observed_outcome.title: Observed outcome
observed_outcome.description: Exception type and message fragment, or the wrong output value, as the alert reports it. From section 'Alert'.

red_ci_run_url.title: Red ci run url
red_ci_run_url.description: CI run of the test-only commit showing the failure. From section 'Red Test (committed FIRST)'.
